_about: Prompts and settings for tools/comfy_batch.py. Edit the style lines to steer the look; names and seeds come from the game data.
style: flat vector illustration in the style of 1960s space programme press art, clean geometric shapes, limited palette, soft two-tone shading, no outlines, no text, no logos
negative: photograph, photorealistic, blurry, noisy, text, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, 3d render, deformed hands, extra limbs

portrait.prompt: Repaint this portrait as a {style}. Keep the same person: same face shape, skin tone, hair colour and style, eye colour, expression and glasses if present. Head and shoulders of a {era} {nationality} {role} in a {suit} flight suit, {gender}, looking at the viewer, plain dark navy background.

hardware.prompt: Repaint this spacecraft silhouette as a {style}. Keep exactly the same outline, proportions and orientation. A {name}, {kind}, {nationality} space programme of the 1960s, centred, on a plain solid bright green background #00ff00.

prompts.title: Wide painted key art, {style}: a Saturn-class rocket and an R-7 rocket rising on opposite sides of a night sky over a launch complex, the Moon large above, 1957 to 1977 space race, cinematic but flat, no text
prompts.newscast_usa: Television news studio of 1965, {style}: an empty anchor desk at the left, a world map and clocks behind, broadcast lights, muted colours, no people, no text
prompts.newscast_ussr: Soviet television news studio of 1965, {style}: an empty anchor desk at the left, a map of the USSR and a red banner behind, muted colours, no people, no text
prompts.endgame_usa_win: Celebration painting, {style}: an Apollo capsule and parachutes over an aircraft carrier, ticker tape, 1969, triumphant, no text
prompts.endgame_usa_lose: Sombre painting, {style}: an empty launch pad at dusk at Cape Canaveral, a lowered flag, 1977, no text
prompts.endgame_ussr_win: Celebration painting, {style}: cosmonauts on Red Square, red banners, a lunar lander silhouette above, triumphant, no text
prompts.endgame_ussr_lose: Sombre painting, {style}: an empty pad at Baikonur on the steppe at dusk, a lowered red flag, 1977, no text
